## Review request

The author requests a fresh review bound to the exact current head/tree. The reviewer should classify:

```text
APPROVE_EXACT_HEAD
COMMENT_NONBLOCKING
REQUEST_CHANGES
SPLIT_REQUIRED
BLOCKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE
BLOCKED_AUTHORITY
```

Any source change invalidates an earlier exact-head approval.
